description: English Wikipedia's most-viewed articles on 1 November 2026 from the Wikimedia pageviews API, without the main page and special, project and talk pages (click a bar or dot to read the article). Statistics idea: Zipf's law. On log-log axes views against rank fall close to a straight line, a power law views ≈ C · rank^(−s); the fit gives s. Caveats: the API lists only the top 1000, views include some automated traffic, and news spikes bend the head of the curve.
name: Most-read on Wikipedia
